title: Magic Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Flameblade Icon.png |caption= A [[Flameblade]] |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW |other= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Magic Gear|Magic Gear|BotW, Series}} is an archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} ==Location and Uses== The Magic Gear is a set of [[Weapon]]s that are made in areas of great elemental power, such as [[Death Mountain]], the [[Hebra Mountains]], and [[Hyrule Ridge]].{{Cite|{{Big|Flameblade}}
This magical sword was forged in the lava of Death Mountain. It leaves white-hot flames in its wake when the blade glows red.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Frostblade}}
A magical sword forged in the frigid mountains of the Hebra region. When the blade glows blue, enemies struck by it will become frozen.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Thunderblade}}
A magical sword forged and refined by lightning from the Hyrule Hills. When the blade shines with a golden light, it will electrocute enemies struck by it.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Great Flameblade}}
This magic-infused greatsword was forged in the fires of Death Mountain by Goron smiths in an ancient age. Attack when the blade glows red to expel flames.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Great Frostblade}}
This magic-infused greatsword was forged by smelting ore found in the Hebra Mountains' permafrost. Attack when the blade glows blue to expel freezing air.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Great Thunderblade}}
This magic-infused greatsword was forged by the Hyrulean royal family using lightning from the Hyrule Hills. Attack when the blade glows golden to expel lightning.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Flamespear}}
A magical spear forged in the magma of Death Mountain. Attack when the blade glows to expel powerful flames.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Frostspear}}
A magical spear forged from ancient ice taken from the Hebra Mountains. Attack when the blade glows blue to chill the air and freeze your foe.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Thunderspear}}
A magical spear that contains thunder from Thundra Plateau in its tip. Attack when the blade glows with a golden light to unleash an electrical attack.|Inventory|BotW}} They come in three varieties: flame, frost, and thunder. Flame weaponry was made by ancient [[Goron]] smiths using [[Lava]] from Death Mountain, and they set [[Enemy|Enemies]] and [[Object]]s on [[Fire]] when used. Frost weaponry was made using ancient [[Ice]] and ore from the Hebra Mountains and will freeze Enemies when used. Lastly, thunder weaponry was forged by the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] using lightning from Hyrule Ridge and [[Thundra Plateau]], and they electrocute any Enemies that they are used against. Since they are made of metal, pieces of Magic Gear can attract Lightning when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They also sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]].
